subject: The review

outcomes.when: the player offers to help with the bad review, or asks what she needs or what it pays
outcomes.reply: Thank you for writing back. It's a 1-star on Pug Café by espresso_or_death, whoever that is, and it's dragging the whole page down. Can you just... make it go away? I'll pay 30.

hints: It's the 1-star on Pug Café's Yowl page, by espresso_or_death. 30 DOLR if it's gone.

hack.goal: delete the 1-star review espresso_or_death left on Pug Café's Yowl page

path.name: Yowl
path.description: the review site yowl.com where the review is

path.name: Pug Café
path.description: Pug's 24/7 café at 3 Linden Ave, run by Brynn LeClaire, the business the review is about

path.name: espresso_or_death
path.description: the username of the Yowl account that wrote the review

hack.reply: You're a lifesaver. It's gone — thank you. I'll send the 30 tonight.

body: Pug Café's 1-star by espresso_or_death on Yowl: 30 DOLR to make it go away.
